text:
Harper Lee: Quick sync 14C Atlas: CloudHarbor co-webinar next Wed 14:00 PT. We're doing a hybrid studio stream + live booth demo (Redwood Dedicated + CloudHarbor marketplace flow). Need final runbook: speaker order, studio capture, live-demo rollback, swag handoff, and marketplace publish timing.

Noah Zhao: I'll own routing and rollback. Plan: booth appliance (local private) -> Redwood Dedicated (us-west-2) -> Hosted API as last resort. Canary 75/25 initial. Trigger to fallback: p95 > 500ms for 45s OR any sustained 5xx > 0.6%.

Imani Brooks: I'll run studio production and speaker ops. Proposed flow: 13:50 intro (Harper), 14:00 CloudHarbor listing demo (CloudHarbor PM), 14:12 Redwood infra + live inference (Noah), 14:24 live Q&A and raffle, 14:30 wrap. Need speaker bios + headshots by Mon EOD; final run-of-show by Tue 12:00.

Diego Ramos: Swag & logistics: 140 sticker packs, 50 polos, 20 travel chargers. Kits manifest: SKU RDW-CH-SUMMITKIT qty 10. Courier: Gateways AWB GW334455. ETA venue Tue 18:00. Tracking: https://gateways.example/track/GW334455. Customs: attach ECCN + commercial invoice.

courier-bot: Gateways update: AWB GW334455 scheduled for delivery Tue 18:12. Customs hold cleared pending vendor EIN.

Noah Zhao: Healthcheck for booth appliance: `curl -s http://10.9.8.7:8080/health | jq -r .status` expected "ok". Prewarm KV cache with a small loop during booth dry-run.

Imani Brooks: Studio AV checklist: dual camera capture (presenter + demo screen), backup HDMI capture device, stream laptop, ethernet + failover cellular hotspot, 2x lapel mics. Onsite volunteer: Priya (CloudHarbor) confirmed.

Noah Zhao: Test script for failover simulation (run from staging):

```
# simulate ramp + check errors
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "X-RW-Route: booth" -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' &
done
wait
```

Harper Lee: Marketing timing: CloudHarbor wants marketplace listing live at 15:30 PT same day and a joint post at T+20m. Need three copy variants + one screenshot by Tue 18:00. Legal signoff required by Tue 12:00.

Diego Ramos: I uploaded packing manifest and commercial invoice to Drive: `drive.example/redwood/cloudharbor/manifest.pdf`. Gateways requested vendor EIN; provided it this morning.

stream-bot: Reminder: rehearsal scheduled Tue 16:00 PT. Recording will go to s3://redwood-events/cloudharbor/ and auto-transcribe.

Noah Zhao: We'll pin model version to avoid auto-updates: `model: rw-llama2-q4k-v1.3` and enable `auto_rollback=false` during demo window. Also enable light quantization profile for the booth.

Imani Brooks: For reliability, prep a 90s pre-recorded demo clip (S3 + local USB) as fallback. If live demo latency >30s or errors exceed threshold, switch to clip and call it out on stream. Also prepare a short intro lower-third graphic "Redwood x CloudHarbor".

Harper Lee: Raffle logistics: we'll scan attendees with a QR that posts to a short form; raffle winners announced at 14:25. Diegos, can you include 5 VIP passes in swag crates for the raffle?

Diego Ramos: Yes, adding 5 VIP lab access passes in crates 1-3. Will update manifest.

Noah Zhao: Observability: push traces to shared OTLP collector and add Grafana panel for demo window. Create SLO: error_rate < 0.6% and p95 < 500ms. Automations: webhook to #partnerships if SLO breaches and a console route flip API call.

Imani Brooks: Stream checklist to capture: slides, screen share of marketplace flow, camera on demo hardware, and a B-roll 60s intro. Media: request produced 5-min highlight clip post-event.

courier-bot: Note: Gateways requests printed customs invoice on crate label. Local contact at venue: Amir +1-555-2222. Delivery will be to Loading Dock C.

Noah Zhao: Quick smoke test command for signing + request throughput (example):

```
# smoke sign + send
payload='{"input":"healthcheck"}'
openssl dgst -sha256 -sign key.pem <(echo -n "$payload") > sig.bin
curl -s -X POST https://private.redwood.local/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $(base64 < sig.bin)" -d "$payload"
```

Harper Lee: Action items recap: @Noah run failover tests + pin model by Tue EOD; @Diego confirm Gateways delivery + manifest update by Tue noon; @Imani finalize run-of-show + pre-record clip by Tue 12:00; @Marketing/Legal finalize copy by Tue 12:00. Reply with :white_check_mark: when done.

Noah Zhao: :white_check_mark: will run tests Tue night and pin model.

Diego Ramos: :white_check_mark: Gateways confirmed and manifest updated.

Imani Brooks: :white_check_mark: run-of-show uploaded and fallback clip on S3.

courier-bot: Delivery confirmed GW334455 delivered Tue 18:14 to Loading Dock C.
